flags.message: The snapshot carries two 'DISTRIBUTED for Conference of 9/28/2026' entries (Jul 15 and Sep 9, 2026) while context.json freezes distribution_count at 1. I read the second as a redistribution to the same conference after the brief in opposition, and forecast the relist-increment claim from the frozen count of 1. If the resolution-time parser counts the two entries separately, that claim would resolve against a different baseline than the one I was shown.

No brief in opposition was provisioned: documents.json shows the fetch ran on 2026-07-18, before the BIO (Aug 26) and reply (Sep 11) were filed, and the response itself was only requested by the Court on Jul 27. As a forward cell I fetched both from the supremecourt.gov links in the snapshot and read them. A re-provision of this case's documents after the response-requested entry would give every predictor the same BIO.
